overall_reason: Files arrive one at a time with a short 3 px rise while only the count's digit rolls, and the list empties after a visible press on 'Clear'; every motion has a job and the reset has a seen cause.

score.reason: T-CHOREOGRAPHY, T-CONTINUITY and T-DEMO-LOOP pass; the frames of the clear transition fall between stills.

strengths: Only the changed digit rolls ('2' rolls out and '3' rolls in over 420 ms) while 'files' stays still, so the count changes only what changed (MOT-254).
The files enter with a 250 ms fade and 3 px rise as each arrives (1 file at 1608 ms, 3 at 2615 ms), not as a cascade on load.
The reset follows a pressed 'Clear' at 4009 ms and ends on 'No files yet' at 5505 ms, a seen cause (MOT-245).
not_investigated: Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
